notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Harabaz Druid, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Harabaz Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
